csv_project_name: CI & CA for Whipple Avenue & 4th/3rd Street
csv_scope_of_work: Stark County is seeking a qualified firm to provide construction inspection and construction administration for a project to be constructed in 2026. The project consists of widening Whipple Avenue to add dedicated left turn lanes to the north and south approaches at the 4th Street intersection and reconstruct a new traffic signal. Safety improvements will also be constructed at the intersection of Whipple Avenue and 3rd Street by removing the existing traffic signal and converting the traffic movements to right-in and right-out by adding concrete islands. Construction inspection and administration services will include on-site observation, daily logs, documentation of pay quantities, prevailing wage documentation, material acceptance testing and certification monitoring, Maintenance of Traffic documentation, claims/change order review and processing, and review of project schedules and submissions.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Feasibility Studies, Inspection Services, Traffic Design Engineering
